--- /dev/null
+++ b/openlibrary/plugins/importapi/import_validator.py.bak
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+from typing import Annotated, Any, TypeVar
+
+from annotated_types import MinLen
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+NonEmptyList = Annotated[list[T], MinLen(1)]
+NonEmptyStr = Annotated[str, MinLen(1)]
+
+
+class Author(BaseModel):
+    name: NonEmptyStr
+
+
+class Book(BaseModel):
+    title: NonEmptyStr
+    source_records: NonEmptyList[NonEmptyStr]
+    authors: NonEmptyList[Author]
+    publishers: NonEmptyList[NonEmptyStr]
+    publish_date: NonEmptyStr
+
+
+class import_validator:
+    def validate(self, data: dict[str, Any]):
+        """Validate the given import data.
+
+        Return True if the import object is valid.
+        """
+
+        try:
+            Book.model_validate(data)
+        except ValidationError as e:
+            raise e
+
+        return True

+from openlibrary.plugins.importapi.import_validator import StrongIdentifierBookPlus, ValidationError
+
+# Test 1: Valid with ISBN-10
+try:
+    s = StrongIdentifierBookPlus(title="Beowulf", source_records=["key:value"], isbn_10=["0123456789"])
+    print("Valid ISBN-10: Success")
+except ValidationError as e:
+    print(f"Valid ISBN-10 failed: {e}")
+
+# Test 2: Valid with ISBN-13
+try:
+    s = StrongIdentifierBookPlus(title="Beowulf", source_records=["key:value"], isbn_13=["9780123456789"])
+    print("Valid ISBN-13: Success")
+except ValidationError as e:
+    print(f"Valid ISBN-13 failed: {e}")
+
+# Test 3: Valid with LCCN
+try:
+    s = StrongIdentifierBookPlus(title="Beowulf", source_records=["key:value"], lccn=["abc123"])
+    print("Valid LCCN: Success")
+except ValidationError as e:
+    print(f"Valid LCCN failed: {e}")
+
+# Test 4: Missing all identifiers (should fail)
+try:
+    s = StrongIdentifierBookPlus(title="Beowulf", source_records=["key:value"])
+    print("Missing identifiers: Success (unexpected)")
+except ValidationError as e:
+    print(f"Missing identifiers failed as expected: {e}")
+
+# Test 5: Empty ISBN-10 list (should fail)
+try:
+    s = StrongIdentifierBookPlus(title="Beowulf", source_records=["key:value"], isbn_10=[])
+    print("Empty ISBN-10 list: Success (unexpected)")
+except ValidationError as e:
+    print(f"Empty ISBN-10 list failed as expected: {e}")
+
+# Test 6: ISBN-10 list with empty string (should fail)
+try:
+    s = StrongIdentifierBookPlus(title="Beowulf", source_records=["key:value"], isbn_10=[""])
+    print("ISBN-10 list with empty string: Success (unexpected)")
+except ValidationError as e:
+    print(f"ISBN-10 list with empty string failed as expected: {e}")
+

+    print("Multiple identifiers (one empty, one valid): Success")

+    print("All identifiers empty lists: Success (unexpected)")
